turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Hello and thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. My name's Sofia. What can I do for you today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, a stone cracked my windscreen and I'm stressed about the cost. How much would I have to pay?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm so sorry to hear that, Mr Bennett, that must be really stressful. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Oliver Bennett, 9 April 1977.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. And can you confirm your policy number or postcode?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's RM8 7LB.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sorry, could you speak up a bit? I'm quite hard of hearing.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Right, where were we.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you have a cracked windscreen and want to understand what you'd pay. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is it only the windscreen that's damaged?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, just the windscreen.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can't you waive the excess? It's only a tiny crack.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Look, as I already said, it's all in the terms and conditions. I don't know how else to explain it.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me just check that for you, would you mind if I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sure, no problem.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.text: [On hold 1:28]

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Mr Bennett, I appreciate your patience. For windscreen-only claims the excess, which is the amount you pay towards a claim yourself, is $50. For other motor claims it's $250.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, that's good to know.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Mr Bennett. Someone will get back to you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've explained the excess that applies.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
